RAP-QL-001.template: If the ratio {personA}:{personB} is {ratioA1}:{ratioB1} and {personB}:{personC} is {ratioB2}:{ratioC2}, what will be the combined ratio {personA}:{personB}:{personC}?

RAP-QL-002.template: What is the simplest whole-number ratio equal to {numerator1}/{denominator1} : {numerator2}/{denominator2}?

RAP-QL-003.template: Given that {personA}:{personB} = {ratioA}:{ratioB}, {personB}:{personC} = {ratioB_prime}:{ratioC}, and {personC}:{personD} = {ratioC_prime}:{ratioD}, what is the ratio between {personA} and {personD}?

RAP-QL-019.template: Find the number which is fourth proportional to {numA}, {numB}, and {numC}.

RAP-QL-020.template: If {varY} varies directly as {varX}, and {varY} is {varY1} when {varX} is {varX1}, what will be the value of {varY} when {varX} is {varX2}?

RAP-QL-030.template: From {initialVolume} litres of {liquidA}, {removedVolume1} litres are replaced with {liquidB}, and then {removedVolume2} litres are again replaced with {liquidB}. What is the final ratio of {liquidA} to {liquidB}?
